description:
Configure KML Regionation optimization for the 'ne_populated_places' layer in the 'ne' workspace. This setting allows large datasets to be efficiently streamed to Google Earth.

1. Log in to the GeoServer web admin interface at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (Username: admin, Password: Admin123!).
2. Navigate to the Layer configuration for 'ne:ne_populated_places'.
3. In the 'Publishing' tab, find the KML Format Settings.
4. Set the Regionation Strategy to 'external-sorting'.
5. Set the Regionation Attribute to 'pop_max' (maximum population).
6. Save the layer configuration.
